name: Frostmere Basin
description: Four camps in a snowed-in basin. Two melt races cross at its centre and cut the ground into quarters, so every neighbour is a bridge away: an inner crossing in the open, or a longer one out under the rim ranges. Four corner tarns and four barrow cairns fill the rest.
theme: Snow, black water, and four armies that all want the same crossings.
